title: OTA units governance config (ota-deployments units.json)
description: The `units.json` at the root of the ota-deployments repo: who owns which unit, Jira project mapping and size limits. TypeScript type `UnitsConfig` in packages/ota-core/src/types.ts, validated by validateUnitsConfig(). Read by ota-cli (`--units`). NAME CLASH WARNING: this is NOT the unit-splitter's `units.json` build output (see units.output.schema.json) and NOT the splitter's input `units.config.json` (see units.config.schema.json). NOT expressible: a Jira project key may be mapped to only one unit (validateUnitsConfig checks it).

$schema.description: Optional editor hint pointing at this schema; ignored by tools.

superAdminTeam.description: GitHub team whose members may approve any command, including host-lane ones and break-glass.

enforceJira.description: Jira validation at verify time is OFF unless true (deferred; DESIGN.md 7.3).

acceptableTicketStatuses.description: Jira statuses acceptable at verify time (only used when enforceJira is true).

defaultSoftLimit.description: Default soft size limit (warn) for units without their own softLimit.

defaultHardLimit.description: Default hard size limit (block) for units without their own hardLimit.

units.description: Per-unit governance, keyed by unit name. Includes the special unit "host" (required).

host.description: Governance of the special unit "host" (the main bundle, patched via the host lane). Required.

bytes.description: Absolute limit in bytes of the patch/full payload.

ratio.description: Limit as a ratio of the unit's embedded base bundle zstd size, e.g. 0.3 = 30%.

ownerTeam.description: GitHub team whose members may approve this unit's commands.

jiraProjects.description: Jira project keys mapped to this unit, e.g. ["TLX"]. A key may appear in only one unit (not expressible).
